primary: Exact two-sided McNemar test on original_0 versus neutral_0 across 96 graphs, alpha 0.05. All returned wrong, invalid and cutoff answers score zero; infrastructure missingness is not zero. No confirmatory test unless all 192 primary slots have usable first responses.
secondary: Graph-cluster bootstrap of mean accuracy across three repeats versus three renamings; repeat agreement; completed-answer accuracy; signed triangle-count errors; cutoff and reported-token counts. Exploratory, no extra confirmatory tests.
selection: Fresh seeds, same Watts-Strogatz n32/k10/p0.22 family and structural eligibility as the motivating study. No response-dependent selection. Same X000..X031 vocabulary; preserve edge/node occurrence order under mapping. Token counts may still vary with identifier frequencies; no semantic causal claim.
retry_policy: Infrastructure only. Never retry wrong, invalid or cutoff output. No previous requests retried.
inference_unit: 96 independent graphs; six related responses per graph
